scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src=path.join('src','config');const dist=path.join('dist','config');if(!fs.existsSync(dist))fs.mkdirSync(dist,{recursive:true});fs.readdirSync(src).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.json')).forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(path.join(src,f),path.join(dist,f)));"
scripts.dev: USE_WASM=1 ONNXRUNTIME_DISABLE_NATIVE=1 TRANSFORMERS_USE_WASM=1 node --loader ts-node/esm src/server/express.ts
